$comment: Asks before a command that loosens the lock's load line, because the lock cannot tell a real waiver from an agent granting itself one. A waiver is the user's call; the lock records it and its reason in waivers.log.

ask.reason: a lock waiver lets one holder past the load line: only the user grants one
--ignore-load skips the lock's load line: only the user grants that
setting WHIPPLETREE_*LOAD_MAX or CHUTE_BOSS_*LOAD_MAX on a command moves the lock's load line: only the user sets a machine's line
direct chute-boss calls must use the project lock shim so its aliases and judge apply
